title: Christmas Bow Shirt, Coquette Holiday Tee, Red Satin Bow Christmas T-Shirt, Pearl and Gold Ribbon Shirt, Girly Xmas Gift, Unisex
description:
A big red satin bow with a fine gold-thread edge, a little stitching and a scatter of cream pearls, printed on the front of a soft tee. A sweet, coquette take on Christmas for anyone who loves bows, ribbons and a pretty holiday look. No words on the shirt, just the art. The design is printed on dark tees: Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather or Asphalt.

Printed and shipped by our production partner
Each shirt is printed for you after you order (direct-to-garment print) and shipped by our print-on-demand production partner in the USA.

Details
- Shirt: Bella+Canvas 3001 unisex jersey tee, retail fit, crew neck, side-seamed, tear-away label
- Material: 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, 4.2 oz/yd² (Dark Grey Heather and Asphalt are cotton/polyester blends, check the size chart)
- Sizes: S to 3XL, unisex adult sizing (runs like a standard men's fit); size up for a looser fit. Youth and toddler sizes are not offered
- Print: design about 11.5 in wide on the front
- Care: machine wash cold inside out with similar colours, tumble dry low or hang dry, do not iron directly on the print, do not dry clean

Production and shipping
- Production: usually 2 to 5 business days
- Shipping (US): usually 3 to 7 business days after production; you get a tracking number by email when it ships

Original artwork by Duskwood Designs Co.
